subject.summary: Acute care nurses provide advanced nursing care to patients with acute conditions or conditions that may deteriorate rapidly, involving assessment, monitoring, care coordination, documentation and cross-team handoff. The specific clinical acts are governed by the workplace nursing registration, institutional rules, role authorization and supervision arrangements.
